This position is eligible for telework. New hires are eligible to apply 30 days after their effective date of hire.
Company Overview
The Metropolitan Transportation Authority is North America's largest transportation network, serving a population of 15.3 million people in the 5,000-square-mile area fanning out from New York City through Long Island, southeastern New York State, and Connecticut. It was founded in 1834, and is headquartered in New York, NY, US, with a workforce of 10001+ employees. Its website is https:/mta.info/.
